name: @tomgrv/vps-coolify
description: Coolify install (self-hosted PaaS on Docker + Traefik)

SYSTEM_COOLIFY_ROOT_USERNAME.description: Admin username created by the installer (empty = create it at first visit)

SYSTEM_COOLIFY_ROOT_EMAIL.description: Admin email created by the installer (empty = create it at first visit)

SYSTEM_COOLIFY_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Admin password created by the installer (empty = create it at first visit)

SYSTEM_COOLIFY_DOCKER_ADDRESS_POOL_BASE.description: Docker address pool base (e.g. 172.20.0.0/16) to avoid clashing with a VPC (empty = installer default)

ports.name: system_coolify_http
ports.note: Coolify proxy HTTP, also required for the Lets Encrypt HTTP-01 challenge (fixed by the installer)

ports.name: system_coolify_https
ports.note: Coolify proxy HTTPS (fixed by the installer)

ports.name: system_coolify_ui
ports.note: Coolify admin UI (fixed by the installer)

ports.name: system_coolify_realtime
ports.note: Coolify realtime (websocket) service the UI connects to (fixed by the installer)

ports.name: system_coolify_terminal
ports.note: Coolify in-browser terminal (fixed by the installer)
